title: Availability DST Audit
user: A consultant, recruiter, or distributed team coordinator who needs proof that published booking availability respects intended local working hours across daylight-saving changes.
smallest_useful_product: A static web tool that accepts weekly hours, IANA zones, and a date range, then renders overlap/DST boundary cases and exports an ICS/CSV expected-slot fixture.
success_measure: For a known DST boundary fixture, it flags every intentionally shifted slot and produces an expected-slot table in under 30 seconds.
constraints: Use the IANA timezone database; explain local-time ambiguity; do not claim parity with every vendor's proprietary availability logic.
